notifications.signedOut: Sign in to see your updates.

footer.tagline: Passes from verified gyms, monthly plans with trainers, and the tools to run your own gym.

landing.title: Run your gym without the paperwork
landing.lead: Members, monthly fees, attendance, reminders, staff and workout plans in one place, on your phone. Members find you, buy passes online and show a QR code at the front desk.
landing.featuresLead: Built with gym owners in Dhaka: simple enough for the front desk, clear enough for the owner.

members.title: Members
members.body: Every member with their package, start date and phone, searchable in seconds.

fees.title: Monthly fees
fees.body: See who has paid and who is due. Online payments go through Kriraghor and reach you as payouts.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: Admit members at the front desk by QR code or a 6-character code, and see the day's visits.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.body: Members get a reminder before their package ends, so renewals don't slip.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: Give your front desk staff only the desks they need: admissions, passes sold, nothing else.

plans.title: Workout plans
plans.body: Trainers sell monthly plans; members follow them and pay each month on Kriraghor.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.earlyAccessBody: Set up your gym and use every tool at no cost while we build the system with the first gyms. Kriraghor's fee on online pass sales still applies.

landing.membersLead: Browse verified gyms by area, see women-only hours, and buy a day, monthly or quarterly pass online.

start.title: Set up your gym on Kriraghor
start.lead: One Kriraghor account works everywhere. Apply as a gym owner, send your documents, then create your gym and open the front desk.

public.title: A gym members can find
public.body: A public gym page with photos, hours and passes members buy online.

private.title: Private gym
private.body: Manage your members, fees and attendance without a public listing. Coming soon.

signIn.body: Sign in or create your account first. You'll come straight back here.

apply.body: Apply for the gym owner role. Next, send your documents for review on kriraghor.com.

documents.applied: You've applied as a gym owner.
documents.body: Send your documents for review on kriraghor.com. We'll tell you when the role is active.

review.body: Your documents are with our team. We'll tell you as soon as your gym owner role is active.

suspended.body: Your gym owner role is suspended. Contact Kriraghor support from the help centre on kriraghor.com.

gym.title: Train with verified coaches
gym.lead: Day passes and monthly memberships at checked gyms, monthly plans with fitness trainers, and gear for your training. Pay online; the gym or trainer is paid once you have trained.

gym.noTrainers: No fitness trainers are listed yet.
gym.noGear: No gym gear is listed yet.
gym.allGear: See all gym gear in the shop

gym.refundRule: A day pass can be cancelled for a full refund until the day starts; an unused day pass is not refunded. A month or 3-month pass can be cancelled for a full refund until you first use it.
gym.notSelling: This gym is not selling passes right now.
gym.signInToBuy: Sign in to buy a pass. You need a verified phone number.
gym.noOpenDays: The gym is not open in the coming days.
gym.dayRefund: Full refund if you cancel before the day starts.
gym.periodRefund: Full refund if you cancel before your first visit.

gym.subscribeRule: You pay one month at a time. The trainer is paid at the end of the month. Cancel in the first {n, plural, one {day} other {# days}} of a month for a full refund.
gym.cancelAtEnd: Cancel? The subscription runs to the end of this month and is not renewed.

desk.profileNotLive: Your fitness trainer profile must be live before you add plans.
desk.planPriceHint: The Kriraghor fee is taken when you are paid at the month end.

gym.gearLead: Dumbbells, supplements and gym wear from verified shops, in the Kriraghor shop.

vendorGym.gate: Gyms are for approved gym owners. Apply as a gym owner first.
vendorGym.title: My gyms
vendorGym.lead: List your gym, set the week and the passes, and admit members at the front desk. Members pay online; you are paid when they use the pass.
vendorGym.editNote: Your changes are not public yet. Send them for review when you are done.
vendorGym.sent: Sent. Staff usually answer within a day.
vendorGym.paused: Sales paused. Passes already sold still work.
vendorGym.photosHelp: {n} photos. At least {min}, at most {max}. The first is the cover.
vendorGym.hoursHelp: Up to four windows a day. Mark a window women-only; a day without windows is closed.
vendorGym.packagesHelp: A day pass is required ({min} to {max}). Month and 3-month passes are optional.

packageProblem.bad_price: Enter a whole taka price for each pass.

desk.title: Front desk
desk.lead: Scan the member's QR code or type the 6-character code. One admission a day per pass.
desk.noCamera: This browser cannot read QR codes. Type the backup code instead.
desk.cameraDenied: The camera is blocked. Allow it in the browser, or type the code.

err.GYM_CLOSED_NOW: The gym is closed now (or this is a women-only window).
err.INVALID_PASS_TOKEN: Not a Kriraghor pass. Check the code.
err.NOT_OWNER: This gym belongs to another owner.

desk.waiting: Scan a pass or type a code.
desk.noneOnDay: No one came in on this day.

sold.title: Passes sold
sold.lead: What each pass paid, the Kriraghor fee and what you receive. A day pass is paid out when it is used or its day ends; a month pass at its first visit.
sold.leadStaff: Passes sold at this gym, with the member and dates. Money stays with the owner.

home.active: You are an approved gym owner.
home.sell: Run a gym? Sell day passes and memberships on Kriraghor.

vendorGym.staffLead: Open the front desk to admit members, or see the passes sold, as the owner allows.
